name: Tenebrae
source:
A cryptic message takes the young vampire to Tenebrae nightclub, where seven incarnations of deadly sins will stand in her way. Now she has to survive among intrigues and solve the mystery of her mother's disappearance. Which circle will you choose, Beatrice?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一则晦涩的信息，将年轻的吸血鬼引向Tenebrae夜总会，七宗罪的七个化身将在那里挡住她的去路。如今，她必须在阴谋中求生，解开母亲失踪的谜团。Beatrice，你会选择哪一重圈层？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782610/]Steam[/url]]
